summary: Gone Ochoco NF lookout: 1920s crow's nest replaced in 1932 by a 90-foot steel tower and cabin, staffed mid-1930s, gone by 1971.

facts.design: Crow's nest (1920s), replaced in 1932 by a 90-foot steel tower with cabin
facts.status_note: Tower and cabin gone by 1971 per both sources; how they came down is not stated
facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Ochoco National Forest

notes_for_editor: Register and firelookout.com agree on the 1920s crow's nest, the 1932 90-foot tower and the 1971 end. Staffing and the 1937 storm come from Central Oregonian items quoted on the Oregon lookouts index page for this site; the index page is headed Wildcat Mountain, Ochoco National Forest, 13S-18E-22 and quotes only Central Oregonian items, but it gives no tower number, so tying the items to this tower is an inference from that heading. height_m 27.4 is 90 ft converted. The 1920s crow's nest has no exact year, so no event was entered for it. No source describes the site today; no modern search result matched this site. Coordinates and elevation in the record match the FFLOS page.
